memory_update.text: The most direct Spruce Pine quartz-to-crucible dependency appears poorly mapped to US-listed pure plays; key named crucible entities include private firms or foreign subsidiaries, so US-listed exposure is likely indirect through broader materials, substrate, CMP, and delivery-system suppliers.

ENTG should remain the reference anchor for critical semiconductor materials and purity, but later layers should avoid over-weighting it because it is already a known large-cap semiconductor materials name.

AXTI is a strong underfollowed follow-up candidate because it combines compound semiconductor substrates, raw materials, China/trade-control sensitivity, and pBN crucible exposure; verify actual scale and customer qualification evidence.

ASYS is a speculative shadow candidate below the preferred market-cap threshold; include only if next evidence confirms recurring CMP consumables/services or advanced-packaging process bottleneck exposure rather than one-off equipment cyclicality.

Gas and chemical delivery subsystems, represented by ICHR and peer UCTT, may be an adjacent chokepoint because semiconductor-grade materials require qualified ultra-clean delivery into process tools; compare ICHR versus UCTT in a later peer pass.

node: Critical semiconductor materials and consumables exposed to policy resilience
summary: Layer 1B expansion found one reference materials leader and three underfollowed or shadow candidates tied to semiconductor materials, purity, CMP, compound substrates, crucibles, and chemical/gas delivery. The strongest direct public-market mappings are Entegris for broad high-purity materials and contamination-control exposure, AXT for compound semiconductor substrates and vertically integrated raw-material/crucible exposure, Amtech Systems for CMP/wafer-cleaning consumables and advanced packaging process equipment, and Ichor for gas/liquid delivery subsystems that sit between specialty materials and wafer-fab tools. The quartz/crucible chokepoint itself appears only partially investable via US-listed names; several most direct entities referenced in the search context are private or non-US-listed subsidiaries, so this pass emphasizes second-order dependencies rather than claiming pure Spruce Pine quartz exposure.
